factual_claims.source_evidence: In summary, Q1 2025 was a period of stability and preparation, with the real estate market moving quietly but steadily toward recovery... Arco Vara’s key near-term challenges remain consistent: achieving successful sales in the Kodulahe and Kuldlehe projects in Estonia, and finalizing the sale of the remaining homes in the Botanica Lozen development in Bulgaria... Q1 2025 was a period of stability and preparation...

numerical_claims.claim: Total revenue for the reporting period reached 1,706 thousand euros, representing an increase of 716 thousand euros compared to 990 thousand euros in the first quarter of 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 1,706 thousand euros (increase of 716 thousand euros vs 990 thousand euros in Q1 2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: In Q1 2025, the group's sales revenue was 1,706 thousand euros, which is 716 thousand euros more than the sales revenue of the Q1 2024 of 990 thousand euros.

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue from the sale of own real estate rose to 1,589 thousand euros from 927 thousand euros, while service and franchise revenues contributed 117 thousand euros compared to 63 thousand euros previously.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 1,589 thousand euros (sale of real estate) vs 927 thousand euros; 117 thousand euros (services/franchise) vs 63 thousand euros
numerical_claims.source_value: 1,589 thousand euros (Q1 2025) vs 927 thousand euros (Q1 2024) for real estate sales; 117 thousand euros (Q1 2025) vs 63 thousand euros (Q1 2024) for services/franchise
numerical_claims.source_evidence: The group's sales revenue was 1,706 thousand euros in Q1 2025... including the sale of real estate in the group’s own development projects 1,589 thousand euros (927 thousand euros in Q1 2024). Other sales revenue in 2025 mainly includes revenue from franchise fees... Franchise fees for the Q1 2025 were 65 thousand euros, franchise revenues for the Q1 2024 were 55 thousand euros.

numerical_claims.source_evidence: In Q1 2025, the group’s operating profit (=EBIT) was 259 thousand euros and net profit 103 thousand euros. In Q1 2024, the group’s operating loss (=EBIT) was 208 thousand euros and net loss 349 thousand euros.
